title: Reading the World
explanation: So far Playground has only written to the world. Playground.getBlock(dx, dy, dz) reads it back -- it returns the block's id, like "stone", "grass_block" or "air".
Combine that with a loop and an if to make code that actually reacts to what's really around you, not just fixed coordinates.
Playground.particles(...) and Playground.giveItem(...) are here too -- flashy, tangible feedback that something happened. Scan the ground in front of you and see what turns up.
